scope: Full coast coarse pass; no fine refinement. Truth used only here after search.

input_design.scope: Full configured Eastern Seaboard rectangle, initial 10 km cells; centers are not fine localization.
input_design.world_model: Same catalog-record-per-target nominal world as the corrected simulator. No observer truth or measurement associations used in preparation.
input_design.bearing_gate: Hard +/-0.5 degrees, matching the corrected truncated Gaussian sensor; underlying sigma=1/6 degree.
input_design.projection_bounds: Broad experimental scale 2.0 and azimuth 30-degree envelopes; conditional bounds, not a measured speed/accuracy guarantee.
input_design.refinement: All surviving regions remain available; center scores never reject their entire cells.
input_design.identity_scope: Each simulator catalog record produces its own physical target. Source physical-identity confidence is not a real-world certificate.
